symbols.name: DomainException
symbols.summary: Base exception class for domain-related exceptions. All domain exceptions should inherit from this class.
symbols.remarks: Domain exceptions represent errors that occur at the domain/business logic layer, as opposed to infrastructure or presentation layer errors.
